# Top level

pkgload::load_all(".")
promiscuityApp()

## promiscuityApp.R
This level 1 main role: Ask for the login credentials, then start the applictaion.

```{r}

promiscuityApp2 <- function(...){

  ui <- shiny::fluidPage(
     tags$head(tags$meta(name = "robots", content = "noindex, nofollow")), # this line prevents search bots to read the content of the app
    shiny::titlePanel("Promiscuity calculation"),
    loginUI("login"),
    shiny::textOutput("login_feedback"),
    uiOutput("promUI")
    )
  
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    
    login_status <- loginServer("login") #ask for login credentials
    # Give feedback on login
    output$login_feedback <- renderText(ifelse(login_status(),
                                               "Succesful Login!",
                                               "Failed Login, Please try angain!"))
    
    # render Promiscuuity UI if login is passed
    output$promUI <- renderUI({
      req(login_status())
      promiscuityUI2("promiscuity")
    })
    
    # load promiscuity server if login is passed
    observeEvent(login_status(), {
      if (login_status()) {
        promiscuityServer2("promiscuity")  
      }
    })
  }
  
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server, ...)
}

```

## Middle Layer

```{r}
promiscuityUI2 <- function(id){
  ns <- NS(id)
  
   shiny::fluidPage(
    shiny::fluidRow(
      shiny::h3("1. Choose Input:"),
      bslib::navset_tab(
        bslib::nav_panel( "1. Upload file", 
                          uploadUI2(ns("upload"))
        ), 
        bslib::nav_panel( "Select input columns", 
                         selectColumnsUI2(ns("columns"))
        ),
        bslib::nav_panel("Choose output", 
                        # chooseUI(id)
        )
      )
    ),
    
    ### OUTPUT PANELS
    h3("input_colnames"), 
    verbatimTextOutput(ns("main_col_feedback")),
    
    h3("results placeholder"),
    DT::DTOutput(ns("df_head"))
  #resultsUI(id)
  )
}

promiscuityServer2 <- function(id){
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    input_df <- uploadServer2("upload")
    
    selectColumnsServer2("columns", input_df)
    
    
    
    main_cols <- reactive(colnames(input_df()))
    output$main_col_feedback <- renderPrint(main_cols())
    output$df_head <- DT::renderDT(head(input_df()))
  })
}
```

# Bottom Layer

chooseColumnsModule 
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
selectColumnsUI2 <- function(id){
  ns <- NS(id)
  fluidRow(
    #shiny::verbatimTextOutput(ns("sub_col_feedback")), # for testing
    bslib::layout_columns(
      shiny::selectInput(ns("idcol"), "ID column:", choices = character(1) ),
      shiny::uiOutput(ns("id_check"))
    ),
    bslib::layout_columns(
      shiny::checkboxGroupInput(ns("hlacol"), "HLA genotype columns:", choices = character() ),
      shiny::uiOutput(ns("hla_check"))
    )

    , DT::dataTableOutput(ns("mid_tab")),
  )
}

selectColumnsServer2 <- function(id, input_df = NULL){
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    # get the column names of input_df
    cols <- reactive(colnames(input_df()))
    # output$sub_col_feedback <- renderPrint(cols()) # for testing
    
    # update the column with patient IDs, when input_df is changed
    observeEvent(cols(), {
      updateSelectInput(session, "idcol", choices = cols() ) 
    })
    
    # check if ID values are unique, and give feedback
    id_check <- eventReactive(input$idcol, {
      ids <- input_df()[[input$idcol]]
      length(ids) == dplyr::n_distinct(ids)
    })
    output$id_check <- renderUI(giveFeedBack(id_check())) # feedback for unique ids
    
    # update hla column options when id col is selected
     observeEvent(input$idcol, {
      updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "hlacol", choices = cols()[cols() != input$idcol] ) 
    })
     
     
     middle_table <- eventReactive(input$hlacol, {
       formatInputTable(input_df(), manual = TRUE, 
                        id.col = input$idcol, hla.cols = input$hlacol,
                        flag.forbidden = T ) |>
        joinGenotypePromiscuity(promiscuity) |>
        dplyr::mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, 4)
     })
     
     #check if all HLA loci are recognised
     hla_check <- eventReactive(input$hlacol, {
       all(middle_table()[["Locus"]] %in% c("A", "B", "C", "DP", "DQ", "DR"))
     })
     output$hla_check <- renderUI(giveFeedBack(hla_check())) # feedback for recognised HLA loci
     
     output$mid_tab <- DT::renderDT(middle_table())
  })
  
}

promiscuityApp2()

```

uploadModule
```{r}
#uploadModule

uploadUI2 <- function(id){
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    shiny::fileInput(ns("file"), 
                     label = "Upload HLA genotype file:", 
                     accept = c(".tsv", ".csv", ".xlsx") ),
    shiny::uiOutput(ns("file_feedback"))
  )
}

uploadServer2 <- function(id){
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    #take the selected file, if any, if no file is selected, dont do anything
    input_file <- reactive({
      validate(need(input$file, message = F))
      input$file
    })
    
    input_df <- reactive({
      readInputFile(input_file())
    })
    
    file_check <- reactive(is.data.frame(input_df()))
    output$file_feedback <- renderUI(giveFeedBack(file_check()))
    
    return(input_df)
  })
}


```


```{r}
giveFeedBack <- function(cond, pass_message = "check passed", fail_message = "check failed"){
    if(cond){
      tagList(
        tags$p(pass_message , style = "color:green;")
      )
    } else {
      tagList(
        tags$p(fail_message , style = "color:red;")
      )
    }
}
```
